name: Holiday at the Beach Parade and Skydiving Santa in Flagler Beach
host: the parade notice in the Flagler Beach news feed
venue: North 6th Street to South 6th Street along A1A
paras: Flagler Beach closes its first December weekend with a parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, when Skydiving Santa drops in at 1 PM and floats follow from North 6th Street to South 6th Street.
The Rotary Club of Flagler Beach sponsors and organizes the parade, and the City of Flagler Beach lists it as the Saturday highlight of its two day Holiday at the Beach celebration.
After the parade, families can walk to the Santa Claus Party from 2 to 4 PM in the City Commission Chambers.
The city also posted a parade traffic plan on November 25, 2026 as a public safety announcement for the day.
tip: Pick a spot along the route before 1 PM so the kids can watch Santa come down from the sky.

name: First Friday Lighting of the Park and Santa Photos in Flagler Beach
host: the First Friday flyer that the city posted on November 5
address: Veterans Park, in front of Flagler Beach City Hall, Flagler Beach, FL 32136
paras: Veterans Park fills with music and lights on Friday, December 4, 2026, as First Friday meets the start of the city's holiday celebration from 6 to 9 PM.
The evening opens with the Lighting of the Park at 6 PM, and pictures with Santa run from 6:20 to 8:30 PM.
Live music, dance and acrobatic performances run from 6:20 to 9 PM, with area elementary, middle and high schools and local community groups hosted by Surf 97.3 radio.
Veterans Park sits in front of City Hall and the city describes it as the center of town, where many city special events are held.
tip: Come at 6 PM for the park lighting, then line up for Santa photos before 8:30 PM.

name: Santa Claus Party after the Holiday Parade in Flagler Beach
host: the special events calendar kept by City Hall
address: Flagler Beach City Hall, Flagler Beach, FL 32136
paras: Families who watch the parade can step inside for a Santa Claus Party on Saturday, December 5, 2026, held from 2 to 4 PM in the City Commission Chambers.
The party is the indoor finish to the two day Holiday at the Beach celebration, which starts the night before with the Lighting of the Park at Veterans Park.
The city's announcement asks residents and visitors of all ages to join the holiday festivities.
tip: Walk over from the parade route when it ends and stay warm inside.

name: Christmas for Kids at Christ the King Lutheran Church in Palm Coast
host: the Christ the King Lutheran Church and Academy events page
venue: Christ the King Lutheran Church & Academy
paras: Christ the King Lutheran Church & Academy hosts Christmas for Kids on Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 9 AM to noon at 5625 US Hwy 1 in Palm Coast.
The morning includes the Christmas story, crafts, music and snacks, and is open to potty-trained 3-year-olds through 5th grade.
The church notes that parents get a few kid-free hours to finish Christmas shopping, and registration is done through an online form linked from the event page.
tip: Register ahead using the form on the church's event page.

name: Gingerbread Man Class at Poppy's True Market in Bunnell
paras: A story and a sweet craft share one hour on Thursday, December 3, 2026, when Bunnell's Poppy's True Market runs its holiday storytime and cookie decorating class from 1 to 2 PM.
The hour starts with a festive reading of The Gingerbread Man, followed by decorating your own gingerbread cookies.
Tickets are $15 each on the market's event page, with a small ticket service fee added at checkout, and ticket sales close at 10 AM on the day of the class.
Visit Flagler lists the class for ages 3 to 8 and notes that spots are limited.
tip: Buy the ticket online before 10 AM on December 3.

name: Photos with Santa at Poppy's True Market in Bunnell
host: the ticket page for the Santa sessions
paras: Sunday, December 20, 2026 brings Santa and Mrs. Claus to a Bunnell market for family mini photo sessions with a professional photographer, scheduled from 11 AM to 2 PM.
The price is $50 per family, and sessions are booked in half hour groups from 11 AM to 2 PM through the ticket page.
The same day, the market also holds its Christmas Market from 10 AM to 4 PM.
tip: Book a half hour group on the market's ticket page before it sells out.
